title: Sam Darnold’s second interception sinks Seahawks as Broncos prevail in overtime

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sam Darnold’s second interception sinks Seahawks as Broncos prevail in overtime
sources.description: Ja'Quan McMillian intercepted Sam Darnold's pass in overtime and Wil Lutz kicked a 53-yard field goal that gave the Denver Broncos a 17-14 victory over the Seattle Seahawks on Thursday night.
